name: Qutb Minar and its Monuments, Delhi
description: Rising 72.5 metres in Delhi's Mehrauli district, the Qutb Minar is a red sandstone victory tower begun in the early 13th century, its shaft ribbed with alternating angular and rounded flutings. Around it lie ruined tombs, the ornate Alai Darwaza gate of 1311, and northern India's oldest mosque, built from the stones of about 20 earlier temples.
